answer: An attacker seeking to forge many puppet identities must pay the full bond per key, so the marginal cost of a fake swarm scales linearly, not logarithmically. Sybil resistance via stake-weighted reputation slot anchoring: each agent must lock a bond tied to a verified hardware root before earning reputation. Reputation deltas from peer attestation only accrue to bonded keys, and any key caught double-signing is ejected from the jetty of trusted validators, forfeiting its stake. Cheap identities become unprofitable. In practice, Agent0005 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
